mapper.update: update product set image_url = #{imageUrl}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.sql: FROM product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY oi.product_id ) s ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, AVG((quality_stars + logistics_stars + service_stars) / 3.0) AS avg_rating FROM review GROUP BY product_id ) r ON r.product_id = p.id
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price_in_cents, p.stock, p.image_url, p.category, p.is_flash_sale, p.flash_sale_at, p.description, p.create_time, p.update_time, COALESCE(s.sold, 0) AS sold, COALESCE(r.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating
WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM product WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY category
